source: Project Wycheproof, https://github.com/C2SP/wycheproof commit 12fd3aaf33eb, testvectors_v1/rsa_pss_*_mgf1_* and rsa_signature_*, converted by scripts/gen_wycheproof_vectors.py. `result` is Wycheproof's: valid, invalid, or acceptable for an input a correct implementation may take either way. PSS with MGF1 over the same hash and a salt as long as the hash, six files; PKCS#1 v1.5 with SHA-256, SHA-384 and SHA-512 at 2048 bits and SHA-256 at 3072 and 4096. A `key` case gives a modulus and exponent, as big-endian hex that may have a leading zero byte; the `verify` cases that follow name it.
